facts.value: The dispatcher ignores the return values of TRKSetBufferPosition and TRKReadBuffer1_ui8. Its command local has no explicit initializer, and it performs the bound comparison without checking whether command extraction succeeded. Consequently, the ordinary out-of-range kDispatchError behavior must not be treated as a guaranteed malformed-buffer error path. There is also no NULL-callback check: normal exclusion of the two trailing NULL entries depends on gTRKDispatchTableSize remaining at the initialized value of 32.
facts.rationale: Adds a useful exceptional-path qualification absent from the retained normal-flow descriptions without asserting an unverified result for failed buffer reads.

evidence.why: Shows trailing NULL entries, initialization to 32, uninitialized command local, ignored buffer-operation results and the sole guard before callback invocation.
